speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with vaginal bleeding and abdominal pain while pregnant; could you tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when this bleeding started?

To better assess the urgency, have you experienced any contractions, fever, or leakage of fluid from your vagina? Also, have you had any prior pregnancies or miscarriages?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (suspicious for placenta previa/accreta given prior C-section, painless or painful bleeding with abdominal pain, and cessation of contractions).

Please immediately request an ultrasound to visualize the placenta and assess the uterine-myometrial interface. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_Ultrasound_Focused_on_Placenta.
